actors.description: Adult male athlete. In the first view (0.0–2.04 s) he is framed in a medium close-up facing the camera in a tree-lined park, wearing a teal/blue sleeveless athletic top, a black headband with a trailing tail, and a lavalier microphone clipped at his collar. After the cut at 2.08 s he is seen in left profile on a red running track/court inside chain-link fencing, wearing the same blue sleeveless top, black training pants and white sneakers, facing and traveling toward screen-right while performing a standing long jump.
Background pedestrian woman visible only in the first view, at frame-right on the park path; dark jacket over a light top, holding a pink/red smartphone, walking away from the camera.
Distant bystander behind the chain-link fence at the left edge of the second view, in dark clothing with a red accent, standing near the fence line; no sports action performed.

shots.storyline: The clip contains two views separated by a hard cut at 2.08 s. From 0.0 to 2.04 s the camera holds a medium close-up of S01-P01 standing among trees in a park, speaking directly to the lens with small hand gestures near his chest; S01-P02 walks along the path at frame-right looking at her phone. No jump technique occurs in this view. At 2.08 s the view cuts to a wide side-on shot of an outdoor red track enclosed by chain-link fencing with residential buildings behind; S01-P03 stands far behind the fence at left. S01-P01 is already in a left-profile start stance facing screen-right with both arms locked straight overhead (held 2.08–2.72 s). He then lowers into a crouch (knee/hip flexion onset 2.56 s, deepest around 3.28 s, held loaded until ~3.60 s) while his arms travel from overhead down past the front of his body (2.72–3.04 s) and then swing backward to a rear-loaded position behind the hips (peak ~3.28–3.60 s). He next drives both arms forward and upward (3.68–4.24 s) while extending hips, knees and ankles to push off (leg extension ~3.92–4.32 s), launching a standing long jump that translates toward screen-right. He is airborne with the body extended and arms overhead (flight 4.32–5.04 s, apex ~4.48 s), then lands feet-first ahead of the takeoff spot and absorbs the impact by flexing knees and hips into a deep squat (landing absorption 5.04–5.44 s, arms dropping low in front). From 5.52 s he rises out of the squat, swinging the arms from low/front up to overhead as the torso lifts, reaching an upright stand by ~6.32–6.48 s. In the final second (6.56–6.96 s), still standing with feet planted, he lowers the arms from overhead and swings them forward/outward in a demonstrative gesture; the clip ends before any further movement, so this tail action is cropped. Throughout, a top-right channel watermark is constant and white Chinese subtitles change three times.

actions.evidence: Frames 2.08–2.72 s: immediately after the cut, S01-P01 stands upright in left profile, feet together/planted on the red track, both arms fully extended vertically overhead, no joint flexion yet — a held preparatory start stance before the jump.
actions.detail: Static start posture facing screen-right; arms locked overhead, body vertical. Not a propulsive swing; recorded as 'other' to mark the jump's initial configuration, which is already present at the first frame of the shot (the overhead raise itself is not observed).

actions.evidence: From 2.56 s the knees and hips begin to flex (progressive descent 2.64–2.96 s), reaching a deep loaded squat by ~3.12–3.28 s with thighs near parallel and torso inclined forward; both feet remain planted throughout.
actions.detail: Preparatory countermovement lowering the centre of mass while facing screen-right; depth increases monotonically to the lowest point around 3.28 s, and the loaded position is then held until the forward swing begins (~3.60 s).

actions.evidence: Arms leave the overhead hold at ~2.72 s and travel downward, passing in front of/low relative to the torso (2.80–3.04 s), then swing backward past the hips with hands behind the thighs/rear-up (3.12–3.60 s), synchronized with the crouch.
actions.detail: Bilateral preparatory arm swing from vertical to a rear-loaded position; the hands move screen-left/behind the body relative to the screen-right-facing trunk, storing elastic energy for the jump. Rear-loaded peak is held ~3.28–3.60 s.

actions.evidence: From ~3.68 s the arms reverse direction, sweeping from the rear-loaded position forward and upward (3.76–4.08 s arms rising in front of the torso; 4.16–4.24 s arms extended overhead ahead of the head) with motion blur indicating speed.
actions.detail: Propulsive bilateral arm swing toward screen-right/upward, leading the trunk extension; overlaps the start of leg extension. Full overhead arm extension reached by ~4.24 s as the feet begin to unload.

actions.evidence: Hips, knees and ankles extend from the deep squat beginning ~3.92 s (torso rising and inclining forward 4.0–4.24 s); by 4.24–4.32 s the body is fully rising on plantar-flexed feet and ground contact is lost at ~4.32 s.
actions.detail: Triple-extension push-off driving the body forward and upward toward screen-right; final toe-off estimated at 4.32 s given 25 fps sampling.

actions.evidence: Feet unsupported from 4.32 s: 4.40–4.64 s the body is fully airborne and extended with arms overhead, translating screen-right; 4.72–5.04 s the body descends with the legs swinging forward to prepare for landing; no ground contact in this window.
actions.detail: Ballistic flight phase of the standing long jump toward screen-right; apex around 4.48 s, then descent with forward leg recovery. First ground contact occurs at ~5.04 s.

actions.evidence: First ground contact near 5.04 s with both feet ahead of the takeoff position, followed by rapid knee and hip flexion into a deep squat by 5.28–5.44 s; arms drop low in front of the body during absorption.
actions.detail: Two-foot landing with residual forward momentum toward screen-right, dissipated by eccentric lower-limb flexion to the deepest squat at ~5.44 s.

actions.evidence: From 5.52 s the athlete extends out of the landing squat (hips/knees opening 5.6–6.24 s) while swinging the arms from low/front (5.6–5.84 s) up to overhead (5.92–6.48 s); by ~6.32–6.48 s he is upright on the track with arms overhead.
actions.detail: Recovery to standing after the jump, facing screen-right; the arm swing to overhead accompanies the rise. The stand-up is essentially complete by the end of this interval.

actions.evidence: Frames 6.56–6.96 s: standing upright with feet planted, S01-P01 lowers the arms from the overhead position (6.56–6.64 s) and then swings them forward/outward to about shoulder height (6.72–6.96 s); no knee/hip flexion or takeoff occurs before the clip ends.
actions.detail: A standing demonstrative arm-swing gesture (or the very beginning of a possible second countermovement) after the completed jump; cropped by the end of the clip at 6.96 s, so its purpose is not fully observable. Recorded as 'other' because no propulsive or landing phase follows within the sampled frames.

uncertainties: The first view (0.0–2.04 s) is a talking-head introduction with small hand gestures only; no jump technique occurs there, so no sport actions are logged for that interval.
The overhead arm position at 2.08 s is already present at the first frame after the cut; the raising of the arms is not observed, so the start boundary of the 'other' stance is the shot cut itself.
Exact toe-off (~4.32 s) and first ground contact (~5.04 s) frames are estimated to the nearest sampled frame at 25 fps; sub-frame timing may differ slightly.
No distinct preparatory heel raise is clearly visible before propulsion, so 'heel raise' is not logged.
It cannot be resolved whether the 6.56–6.96 s standing arm swing is a pure demonstration gesture or the start of a second jump repetition, because the clip ends before any crouch or takeoff develops.
The background pedestrians S01-P02 (first view) and S01-P03 (second view, behind the fence) perform no tracked sports action.
